profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at TaEthni
profile.summary: Principal Engineer / UI Architect with 13+ years building large-scale web platforms, developer tooling, and design systems. Known for bridging product, UX, and backend architecture while leading teams through complex system design and delivery.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected and led development of GenMapper platforms used to assess and visualize the health of global people movements.
Designed a secure, multi-tenant web platform for globally distributed, high-risk users.
Built a centralized Identity Provider enabling secure authorization across internal and external systems.
Created a dynamic runtime translation system allowing applications to be localized on the fly.
Led system design from concept through production while mentoring engineers in performance and architecture.
Established CI/CD standards improving deployment reliability and delivery velocity.
Tech: C#, .NET, Node.js, Python, TypeScript, Angular, Azure, PostgreSQL, K8s, CI/CD, Ionic
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · Angular · C# · ASP.NET · TypeScript · Microsoft Azure · PostgreSQL · K8s · Ionic Framework

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Team Lead / Architect
positions.description:
Led development of a community licensing platform supporting multiple Blizzard game titles.
Designed a configurable onboarding system to integrate new games into customer-support platforms.
Built a shared UI component library adopted across teams to standardize UX and accelerate development.
Drove front-end architecture decisions with a focus on performance, scalability, and maintainability.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · ASP.NET · Node.js · JavaScript · Angular · HTML · Java · SASS · Webpack

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer & Architect
positions.description:
Constructed several client side components.
Collaborated with designers to redesign existing application.
Architected new UI while migrating from AngularJS to Aurelia framework. 
Tech: C#, .Net, .Net Core, Javascript, Node, Aurelia, HTML, Less, Webpack & Gulp.

positions.title: Senior Software UX Engineer
positions.description:
● Developing not only a cross-browser, but also a cross-platform UX framework call aurelia-interface
● Designed UX, Strictly following Google's Material Design, Apple's Humanize design, and Windows guidelines.
● Along with following standard design guidelines, I have created my own UI/UX Design standard.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Architect
positions.description:
● Planned the foundation to an application that would inherit nine other applications.
● Designed strategies that would best fit the financial industry's needs.
● Created rich data visualizations for bankers to map out their workflows.
● Engineered an in-house UX/UI Css and Javascript Library.
● ENV:Aurelia,ES6,JSPMGulp,SASS,Sketch,NEO4J,C#

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Developed cutting-edge cross-platform banking application.
● Architected application security infrastructure.
● Saved company 46 million dollars in programmer time by designing an unbreakable dev environment.
● Implemented and led standard Scrum execution along with 20 other Scrum teams.
● Led a team of 12 Scrum engineers to develop the application's Conversation Deck.
● ENV: BlueJS, Angular, ES5, Gulp, Bower, Less, Node, jQuery

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Supported student development by being an available educational resource.
● Dove into learning several technologies that extend the possibilities of programming, 
   - like ES6, and writing maps from Javascript to other languages like Java, Python ...etc
● Provided hours of hands-on training in AngularJS and other full stack technologies.
● ENV: Angular, Backbone, Bootstrap, NEO4j, Mongo, Redis, SQL

positions.title: Contract Engineer for H-I-S Coatings
positions.description:
●Custom-developed a real-time Customer Relations Platform with rich Enterprise Resource Planning integration for H-I-S Coatings company
● Implemented full featured OAuth system using Laravel and PHP backend with Angular and jQuery on front end
● Employed Google API’s for strategic delivery, routing and just-in-time order scheduling, and platform-wide notifications
● Integrated SQL database to communicate with SQL data store, structured by current Point-of-Sale system
● Engaged company employees with continual A-B testing to improve UX design
● Provided frequent application feedback sessions for overall application health
● TraCom is also used as the sole communications platform between Customer Relations and the Production Management team.
